decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits at the core of the firm's traditional Erzgebirge-style range and was prominently featured on the home page, so the firm's commitment and its fit with the craft heritage favor keeping it.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is a central, low-risk staple of the established offer and has been visibly promoted, so management will persist with it.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs represents a substantial, publicly showcased investment in a new direction, and the firm kept extending it with new discs in 2019, which signals escalating commitment despite its distance from the core.
The motif platform got a second edition and its own page, which shows active reinvestment and public commitment, though as a themed add-on it is more expendable than the base system.

The Christmas motif platform is a seasonal add-on tied to the music box system the firm is committed to, so weak sales can be attributed to seasonality, but its peripheral nature makes it the most likely candidate for pruning.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's pyramid expertise and was featured on the home page, so it fits the announced craft identity and is likely retained.
